Problem: DesignReviewGraphics.matrixPlot draws one geomTile per cell and embeds every value in the plot description (cap maximumCells = 200000). At 80 columns × 600 scans that is ~48k Rect primitives and a ~48k-number description per recompile: hundreds of ms and multi-MB SVG. It is also time-horizontal and paged (4–16 columns).
Need: a time-down, unpaged recipe backed by one raster (RasterImage + Grob.image with Nearest interpolation), per-column |max| scaling for task columns, and a muted class for nuisance (the studio colours per class; Intaglio raster colouriser is IN1 in Intaglio). Values for export go to a CSV sidecar, not the description. Plus term-level incremental rebuild so one term edit recompiles only that term's columns (studio edits rebuild on every change).
Reference: the mock's renderSheet raster (summary columns per nuisance kind; zero = paper; ≤35% ink for nuisance).
Acceptance: 80 × 600 renders well under 50 ms; SVG size bounded; one-term rebuild measurably cheaper than a full build.
